categories.name: W. Paying for a held booking (SPENDS REAL MONEY)

cases.title: Paying takes exactly the booking amount from the wallet

rows.label: Result
rows.value: Booking BK-3 (order AGN9809UPLUPLORD261005KSDT7A, GDS PNR OU2K41, airline PNR JXROTA): Hold pressed by the tester, PNR locked with 'Take Control' (tester's instruction), then 'Confirm To Pay' pressed by the tester. Paying took EGP 35,197.40 from the wallet but the booking is worth EGP 32,031.40 (Total Cost Payable). The difference, 3,166.00, equals the seat total, so the seats were charged twice. Wallet History: debit 35,197.4 (transaction NDCEG-TR261005piQ33k), end balance 982,035 after 30,013.4 for BK-2. Payment tab shows 'Amount Received 35,197.40' against 'Total Cost Payable 32,031.40'. Evidence: evidence/PAH-002_wallet-history.png

cases.title: A price change between hold and payment is shown before paying

rows.label: Result
rows.value: Booking BK-3 (order AGN9809UPLUPLORD261005KSDT7A, GDS PNR OU2K41, airline PNR JXROTA): Hold pressed by the tester, PNR locked with 'Take Control' (tester's instruction), then 'Confirm To Pay' pressed by the tester. No price change happened between hold and payment (amount due stayed 32,031.40), so the 'price change is shown before paying' behaviour could not be seen. Needs a booking whose price changes

cases.title: Extras bought with a booking are visible in the reports

rows.label: Result
rows.value: Generic case, checked for the extras OmanAir supports (Seat only). BK-2: the Wallet History amount 30,013.4 includes the seat charge (1,148) and is traceable to the order by order id and transaction id. Limitation: the Statement Report showed nothing (see RPT-002), and for BK-3 the wallet amount 35,197.4 does not add up (see PAH-002)

items.body: The wallet was debited 35,197.40 EGP. The payment record shows Total Cost Payable 32,031.40 but Amount Received 35,197.40. The extra 3,166.00 equals the seat total, so the seats were charged twice. The e-ticket shows the correct total of 32,031.4.

fields.label: Expected
fields.value: Paying the held booking should take exactly the booking amount from the wallet, 32,031.40 EGP, because the seats are already inside that amount.

fields.label: Impact
fields.value: The agency is overcharged by EGP 3,166.00 on every pay-after-hold booking that has paid seats, and the wallet, payment record and ticket disagree.

fields.label: Severity
fields.value: High - money is taken from the agency in error.

items.evidence: See evidence/ in the run folder.

items.body: The seat map offered the seats, the hold was accepted, and the booking was ticketed (tickets 91041001021062 adult, 91041001021073 child, 91022013762584 infant) with the adult on 24A and the child on 25A. No refusal or warning appeared at any step.

fields.label: Expected
fields.value: The platform's rule says an adult with an infant and a child may never sit in an exit seat. The seat should be refused, at the latest when the booking is made or ticketed.

fields.label: Impact
fields.value: A passenger who may not sit in an exit row is ticketed there, which breaks an airline safety rule and would reach the airline.

fields.label: Severity
fields.value: High - safety rule not applied.
